body: Cross-device reactions ARE wired end to end, so the bug is not a missing hop: VibeWeb.ChatChannel.handle_in('react-message') (server/lib/vibe_web/channels/chat_channel.ex:555) broadcast!s 'message-reaction-updated' with counts only (no isSelected, that is per-caller), ChatEngine.handleNativeSocketFrame (:9407) re-derives isSelected from the local snapshot and calls applyMessageEngagementLocked, and ChatConversationController.handleChatEngineChanged (ios/Sources/App/AppHomeView.swift:13328) refreshRows on chatMessageReactionChanged. Note applyMessageEngagementLocked (:11535) returns changed=false when the message is in neither the live payload nor historyRowsByChat[chatId] — and on changed=false NOTHING is posted, so no refresh happens. That silent-drop path is the first place to look for 'the other device only sees the reaction after I close and reopen the chat'.
author: Vibe Team
